title: Reproducibility Report for SC25 Paper MXBLAS: Accelerating 8-bit Deep Learning with a Unified Micro-Scaled GEMM Library
problem: Reproducibility is critical for scientific computing research but reproducing others' work is often challenging. This report documents artifact evaluation results for the MXBLAS paper.
motivation: SC25 Reproducibility Initiative aims to improve research reproducibility by systematically evaluating artifacts. This report provides details of the evaluation process and findings.
method: An independent evaluator (Roberto R. Exposito) attempted to reproduce the MXBLAS paper's results by running its code on real hardware, following the artifact evaluation standards of SC25 (a major supercomputing conference). They examined the complete artifact—software, source code, and test data—and reviewed the Artifact Description and Evaluation appendix, which documented what tests were run and how.
key_novelty: Independent validation that MXBLAS's results for accelerating 8-bit deep learning can be reproduced using the paper's released code.
hardware_target: Target hardware depends on MXBLAS paper
limitations: This is a reproducibility report, not a novel contribution paper. Details depend on the original MXBLAS work.
